version.changelog:
- Updated bundled scanner binary to version v0.9.0 (from v0.8.0)
- Documentation (SKILL.md) updated to reflect new binary version
- SHA-256 checksum for the scanner binary remains unchanged

llm.summary: This is a local skill-scanning wrapper with an explicitly optional report-upload feature; the main risk is that uploaded reports may contain sensitive review details.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to audit local skill packages before installation; reading target skill files, writing reports, and optionally invoking an external scanner are coherent with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are user-directed and repeatedly state that upload and external-engine modes are disabled by default, but the enterprise example uploads full scan summaries and findings to a user-supplied endpoint.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The documentation describes a bundled Linux x64 binary and checksum verification, but the inspected artifact contains documentation, agent metadata, and build-info JSON rather than the binary itself, so users should verify package completeness and provenance.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Local file reads are proportionate for scanning skills. Network access is optional and tied to --upload-url, but reports may still disclose sensitive metadata, paths, prompts, or proprietary findings.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No startup hooks, background persistence, credential access, privilege escalation, destructive commands, or automatic network behavior were evident in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust the publisher or can verify/build the scanner yourself. Use the local scan mode by default; enable --upload-url only for trusted internal HTTPS endpoints after reviewing the report contents, because findings and summaries can still reveal sensitive project details.
llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The upload concern is partially supported: INSTALL.md says full scan summaries and findings are uploaded when --upload-url is used, while SKILL.md states uploads are disabled by default and source code, credentials, and system configuration are not transmitted.
